index.scope: Both advanced enrollment and simple setup ran a compound repair through Railway. The simple form selected indexes and PostgreSQL verified the exact discovered key pair.
index.remaining: Complete general repair authority, single-column and wider shapes, and hosted interruption recovery.

refresh.scope: Railway saved a verified targeted statistics refresh on an owned Rookery lookup. PostgreSQL confirmed one refresh. The measured query went from 16.89 ms to 0.05 ms and protected traffic checks passed.

richer.scope: Simple setup verified retained joint statistics and a measured individual-column trial that restored the prior setting when the query regressed.
richer.remaining: Qualify wider column patterns, permissions and the retained-benefit case for an individual column.

cleanup.scope: Both plain cleanup and the cleanup-trigger setting passed on Railway from simple setup. PostgreSQL independently recorded which action ran.
cleanup.remaining: Qualify general project privileges and more table shapes.

memory.scope: Railway verified a private function-memory repair on Rookery from 4 MB to 32 MB. The same query dropped from 270.37 ms to 190.11 ms and its attributed temporary writes fell to zero. Protected traffic passed.
memory.remaining: Qualify wider project capacity, concurrency and simple setup for function memory.

cron.scope: Railway recorded three original Rookery periods from simple setup with zero manual query IDs. PostgreSQL confirmed the schedule change with 1.9 seconds left. One of the two required scheduler checks completed before the cutoff, and the dashboard saved an inconclusive result.
cron.remaining: Confirm the native schedule change and verify all three follow-up periods through the Railway dashboard.

recovery.scope: The hosted worker inspected a recorded index after a restart and kept the original result honest. Local checks also cover an invalid index and repeated interruptions.
recovery.remaining: Qualify recovery across other repairs, during the database command itself, and under wider project lifecycle changes.

backend.scope: An owner-scoped hosted service validates the dedicated Supabase login and controls its worker and saved history.
backend.remaining: Add automated credential rotation and qualify production account and deployment operations.

dashboard.scope: Railway serves the original landing, account signup, agent setup and saved activity. Repair choices and pause are stored per project.
dashboard.remaining: Drive the new screens from actual hosted repair runs. Complete wider account and operations work.

colorMeaning: Green covers the verified scope on each card. Yellow means part of the card works and more remains. Dashed cards track pending work or qualification.
